meta.generation: sub.txt: form 10-K with fp FY. num.txt: qtrs 0, uom USD, coreg and segments empty, us-gaap version, ddate equal to the filing's period (balance-sheet date). Per filer and balance-sheet date the latest accepted 10-K is kept. A filing is used only if it tags Assets, Liabilities, StockholdersEquity and LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity (presence filter only, never a residual filter). Sample = filings t and t+1 of the same CIK with balance-sheet dates 11-13 months apart; X = year-t values (untagged MinorityInterest / equity incl. NCI / temporary equity / commitments / current items / cash enter as 0), Y = year-(t+1) outputs. Split key t = calendar year of the year-t balance-sheet date (2011-2023). Imposed identity: Assets = LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity. The second identity LSE = Liabilities + (equity incl. NCI, or StockholdersEquity + MinorityInterest) + temporary equity + CommitmentsAndContingencies was measured but not imposed (fails for a sizeable share of filings). Labels are the values as filed; Assets and LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity differ in a small number of filings because of filer tagging errors (typed digits, a total tagged with the Liabilities figure); EDGAR does not reject XBRL calculation inconsistencies. Only Q1/Q2 zips are used, so firms whose 10-K is filed in Jul-Dec (mostly Apr-Sep year-ends) are largely absent. Samples capped at 50000 samples (seed 12345).
